opus.problem: The cited verse (Genesis 22:7) does not say Isaac carried the wood. That detail is in Genesis 22:6, so the clue is not fully supported by its reference. Change the reference to Genesis 22:6-7 or drop the wood detail.

The best-known use of the word is missing: John the Baptist seeing Jesus and saying 'Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!' (John 1:29). 'Lamb of God' is even an accepted answer. A clue on this should replace a lesser one, such as David rescuing a lamb from a lion or bear.
